result:
I changed the Turmas controller so pagination links carry the current filter, but I haven't run it or tested it, so I don't know yet whether it fixes the bug.

I never found a specific line that causes the stale filter. ActiveScaffold, the grid library the app uses, keeps the search in the session by default. The most likely cause is that the session copy goes stale when the filter changes. The page 2 link then loads the old professor filter.

The fix is `config.store_user_settings = false` in `app/controllers/course_classes_controller.rb`. With that setting, ActiveScaffold puts the active search and sort in the pagination and sort links. Page 2 of PERÍODO = 2026/2 should then keep that filter.

Because of the setting, this listing no longer remembers the last search, sort and page between visits.

To check it, filter by professor, remove that filter, filter by PERÍODO = 2026/2, then click page 2. It should show page 2 of 9.
